name: Oral Saathi
description: Document a persistent mouth sore and arrange clinical review.
modelRole: Speech-to-text for worker-reviewed oral symptoms; no image-based cancer prediction.
fields: Difficulty swallowing or opening the mouth
note: A mouth sore has persisted for three weeks. Tobacco use reported. No difficulty swallowing.

name: Skin Saathi
description: Record a rash, wound or persistent patch for an ANM or clinician.
modelRole: Speech-to-text for worker-reviewed symptoms; no skin-disease image classifier.
note: A persistent skin patch has reduced sensation. Arrange clinical assessment.

name: Shishu Breath
description: Support a full-minute breathing count and document danger signs.
modelRole: Speech-to-text for breathing observations; respiratory rate is manually counted, not inferred from video.
fields: Breaths counted over a full minute
Unable to feed, convulsions, severe breathing difficulty or unusual unresponsiveness
note: Four-month-old infant. Fifty-eight breaths counted over a full minute. No general danger signs reported.

name: Matri Check
description: Record symptoms during pregnancy or after birth and support referral.
modelRole: Speech-to-text for confirmed maternal symptoms; referral prompts are explicit rules, not predictive diagnosis.
fields: Convulsions or loss of consciousness reported
Severe headache with blurred vision reported
note: Pregnant woman reports severe headache with blurred vision. No bleeding reported.

name: Poshan Check
description: Record measured MUAC and swelling for children aged 6–59 months.
modelRole: Speech-to-text for measured observations; MUAC classification uses WHO thresholds, not a photo estimate.
fields: Swelling of both feet confirmed by a trained worker
Unable to feed or another general danger sign
note: Child aged two years. Measured MUAC is 112 millimetres. No swelling of both feet.

name: Teeka Reader
description: Read printed card text and prepare a worker-verified vaccination history.
modelRole: Extract printed vaccination-card text; an ANM confirms doses and schedules. No automatic vaccine eligibility decision.
note:
SYNTHETIC IMMUNISATION CARD
BCG 12 Jan 2026
OPV 0 12 Jan 2026
Next visit: date unclear

name: Dawa Follow
description: Read a printed medicine list and record barriers to the prescribed plan.
modelRole: Extract printed prescription text for worker confirmation; no prescribing, dose changes or adherence prediction.
fields: New concerning symptom or suspected medicine reaction
note:
SYNTHETIC MEDICINE LIST
Prescribed medicine: SAMPLE ONLY
Follow-up with ANM. Do not change a dose.

name: Report Reader
description: Read a printed report and prepare verified values for clinical review.
modelRole: Extract printed report text; no clinical interpretation or automatic insertion of unverified values.
fields: Report explicitly marked critical by the laboratory
Test name, value, unit or date unclear
note:
SYNTHETIC LAB REPORT
Report date: 03 Oct 2026
Glucose: 126 mg/dL
Sample context must be checked by clinician.
